sd_main_wall_2.blurb: The biggest of four small walls at Nacho in Spearfish Canyon, near the Savoy end of the canyon. It holds around eleven bolted limestone sport routes, with a few in the low 5.10s and most of the line-up sitting in the 5.11 range before a handful of 5.12s. Expect long, sustained pitches that tend to pump you out rather than test a single hard move. The walls here take plenty of morning sun and are generally kinder in the cooler months. It suits climbers who already lead the 5.10 grades and want something steeper, and it is not a spot for first leads.

sd_spire_four.blurb: Spire Four is the tallest of the Cathedral Spires in Custer State Park and the most visited tower in the group. All ten routes are trad, ranging from an easy low-fifth-class three-pitch line up to a couple of 5.12 pitches, with several in the 5.7 to 5.9 range between. The granite is good, the views from the top are rated highly, and the easiest way up ends with a short step across to the summit. Reaching the base takes a little scrambling, so it feels more like an alpine outing than a roadside crag.

sd_assassin_wall.blurb: A compact sport wall on the left side of the trail into The Mohican in Spearfish Canyon, just past Lady in Red. Ten bolted limestone routes run from an easy 5.8 through a few 5.10s, with the bulk at 5.11 and a couple of 5.12s at the top end. Routes here are rated as some of the better lines in this part of the canyon. The wall is described as cool and shaded, which helps in warm weather, and there is some poison ivy at the base. A good stop for a leader comfortable at 5.10 or 5.11.

sd_elkorn_mountain.blurb: The main formation on Elkhorn Mountain, in the Needles of Rushmore area of the Black Hills. Ten routes are logged here, nearly all trad, spanning roughly 5.6 to 5.11, with most clustered around 5.8. One short ice line adds a winter option at about WI3. It sits in a large, complex area of walls, ridges and spires that is quieter than the roadside crags nearby, and the climbing is on granite. Plan on a real walk uphill to get into the cirque.
